references.name: front-aerial.jpg
references.observed: Complete north-front elevated picture actually inspected: pale rusticated masonry, red-brick side returns, multiple open arcade bays at street level, two projecting faceted corner pavilions with round windows, tall windowed upper stages, domed slate roofs and pierced lanterns, a central multi-story glazed screen and round clock. A broad high arched fanlight and large domed roof with gold-capped lantern rise behind the glazed entrance. Side wings have closed mansard/slate roofs, dormers, rectangular windows and pale cornices. Ornament is simplified original geometry; do not copy lettering or statues.

references.name: whole-station-aerial.jpg
references.observed: Whole station aerial from the south actually inspected: long connected barrel-vaulted train shed with dark muted glass panels, reddish iron arch/end framing, straight side walls and longitudinal roof bands. It terminates behind the ornate domed passenger headhouse. Rail approaches continue south beyond the principal shed. Tall modern hotels and neighboring streets/zoo remain independent context, not parts of the historic station model.

note: Two ordinary pictures plus standard PMTiles only. Local photographs are observation references, not redistributed textures. No bespoke archival or survey research.
